# Nix Dependency Attestation

This is an automated, short-lived attestation for the commit targeted by this
release.

## Verification Scope

The attached `attestation.json` was generated by the repository's Nix
derivation after `nix flake check --no-build` passed. It records:

- the pinned `nixpkgs` revision and NAR hash;
- calculated SHA-256 digests of the Nix, Pub, Go, and Gradle lock inputs;
- the Gradle wrapper distribution and locked Maven repositories;
- the number of locked Pub packages.

The attested values are rendered below for convenient review. Download
`attestation.json` only when a machine-readable report is needed.

## Reproduce

```bash
nix flake check --no-build
nix build .#dependency-attestation
cat result/attestation.json
```

## Retention

This technical release contains no APK or other application binary. It is
replaced by the next successful attestation after an update to `main` and is
also eligible for scheduled cleanup after seven days.

For application source and original authors, see
[pluralplay/FlClashX](https://github.com/pluralplay/FlClashX).
